name: Ryoujoku Katei Kyoushi
source:
Main character can not find a proper job after graduation. One day he happens to be at a traffic accident spot. Suddenly, victim's phone starts to ring and voice requests a tutor. However, he does not want to limit his services to daughter alone, he intends to aim at mother as well.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公毕业后找不到合适的工作。一天他偶然来到了一个交通事故现场。突然，受害者的手机响了，电话那头要求请一位家庭教师。然而，他不想把自己的服务仅限于女儿，还打算将目标对准母亲。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
